title: A PDE approach to quantitative asymptotic stability of the optimal filter in the linear detectable setting
summary: The filtering problem asks to estimate a signal process, the initial state of which is unknown, given its partial and noisy observations. From a probabilistic perspective, the best estimate at each time is the optimal filter, which is the conditional law of the signal given all observations up to the time. The problem of asymptotic stability of the optimal filter, which asks whether the filter initialized with the incorrect initial law converges to the correctly initialized filter, is of fundamental practical and theoretical importance.
